title: Beevibe Architecture Deep Research Decision Context
description: Context notes extracted from the PRD + any pre-built profile tags. These are ANNOTATIONS on the option space, NEVER filters. They are shown alongside the ranked options to help the reader weigh tradeoffs; ADR does not drop any candidate based on them.

tags.description: Flat array of short context tags (e.g. 'phase:pre_pmf', 'deployment:self_hosted'). Sourced from clarification profiles when one was selected. Tags are shown in the report header and passed to synthesis as soft annotations.

category.description: Optional grouping: deployment | compliance | cost | region | integration | data | team | phase.

statement.description: The context note in plain language as the user expressed it.

evidence_from_input.description: Quoted text from the PRD or clarification answers that established this note.
